collision_note: 'complex' = use complex collision as simple on that batch (stair treads, stoops, balcony decks, rear gallery decks and rear stair treads), as the existing *_Collision batches do; skins, fences, sheds and plants are NoCollision. Collision_Only batches collide but never render (gallery guards, stair-opening edges, balcony rails): the apply step spawns them hidden in game, blocking pawns and ignoring the camera and visibility. No collision face comes within 300 cm of a traffic centreline: a unit (a front stair with its head balcony, a porch, a balcony, a rear stack) that would goes to the 'WoodDeckVisual' batches, which have none.

limits: Footprints, street edges, storeys and construction years are data-driven where available. Brick colours, trim colours, door and window rhythm, stair shape and cornice details are rule-and-seed estimates after the Plateau heritage sheets, not surveys of individual buildings. Rear galleries, stairs, fences, gates, sheds, plants and the yard ground cover are rule-and-seed estimates too; lot lines are not mapped, so the rear lot line is taken at the ruelle or halfway to the next building. Yard trees stand where the 2019 canopy survey shows crowns; their species and heights are estimates from crown size.
